blockers.quote: > HOLD: 4 s. Performed. The board flutters and clicks overhead. You tear the teal seal with your thumb; the sheet unfolds; your eyes run down it and stop. Your mouth opens. You read it again, closer. You look left: empty platform. Right: her. You hold the letter out at arm's length.
blockers.why: Check #2 Confirm the click fails: the opening spends more than seven seconds on the stranger, while the thumbnail situation is Min-jun beneath -84.
blockers.fix: Compress the discovery to three seconds: seal tears and +22 snaps at 0:00, cut to Min-jun by 0:03, and land the thumbnail's -84 frame by 0:07. Move the stranger's reaction after that or cut it.

blockers.quote: Your sister's asleep on the sofa after the shift. A sleeping face is still a face.
blockers.why: No new power rule after halfway fails: sleeping faces working is first established at 8:45.
blockers.fix: Wake her before using the power. Replace lines 367-372 with: "Your sister's asleep after the shift. You touch her shoulder. One eye opens. You hold up the result. / You: I made it. / Plus one hundred. Before the other eye opens."

blockers.quote: Just your class, or all of Seoul? Why not go on the news and scan the whole country? Because a camera isn't a face. Your sister's phone settled that. But a crowd is a thousand faces, and this street has one.
blockers.why: Check #21 Close the loopholes on screen fails: the earlier scene shows an audio call with the phone at her ear, so it does not settle the obvious video-call or livestream exploit.
blockers.fix: At line 100, make it a live video call with her face filling the screen. Replace line 106 with: "You switch on video. Her face fills the glass. Nothing opens. A live image is not a face."

suggestions.quote: So. Red means they want you to fail. And your list was right.
suggestions.fix: Make the next climb causal: "Every red card points back to your class. So you trust the list enough to cut harder."

suggestions.quote: The night before, you leave your own notebook on his desk. Every mistake you made this year, and the fix. Half a chocolate bar on top. If he's building a ladder, he can have the good wood.
suggestions.fix: State the price of trying: "It might cost you first place. You leave it anyway. If he's building a ladder, he can have the good wood."

suggestions.quote: And the room, in the glass: teal. Nearly all of it. They were only ever red at the race, and the race is over.
suggestions.fix: Preserve Min-jun as the exception: "And the room, in the glass: nearly all teal. Most of them were red only while this race was alive."

keep.quote: Zero. Grey. One click. The biggest news of your life, and you're a receipt.
He isn't sawing your chair. He's building a ladder. Out of your mistakes. You've been his textbook for two years.
A face in a mirror is still a face. The toilets weren't broken. The one card you can't see was always yours.
